name: Modes
about: A saved way of answering in a conversation: which pipeline answers, with which values, and who fills its roles (a model, a pool, knowledge groups). Made from a conversation in Tessa ("Save as a mode"). Tessa offers every mode; a curated face such as Athena offers only the modes that name it here.
